import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 600; // 500 + 100
    static long mod;
    static Mint[] a = new Mint[MAXN];
    static Mint[] c = new Mint[MAXN];
    static Mint[][] comb = new Mint[MAXN][MAXN];
    static Mint[][][] dp = new Mint[MAXN][MAXN][2];
    static Mint[][][] dpc = new Mint[MAXN][MAXN][2];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        gen_comb((int) (MAXN - 1));

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            a[i] = new Mint(0);
            c[i] = new Mint(0);
        }
        a[0] = new Mint(0);
        c[0] = new Mint(1);
        a[1] = new Mint(0);
        c[1] = new Mint(2);

        for (int i = 2; i <= m; i++) {
            Mint tmp = new Mint(0);
            Mint tmpc = new Mint(0);
            for (int l = 0; l <= i; l++) {
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                tmp = tmp.add(
                        c[l].mul(c[r])
                                .mul(new Mint(s1(1, l) + 1, 0))
                                .mul(comb[i - 1][l])
                                .add(
                                        a[l].mul(c[r])
                                                .add(a[r].mul(c[l]))
                                                .mul(comb[i - 1][l])
                                                .mul(new Mint(i + 1, 0))
                                )
                );
                tmpc = tmpc.add(
                        c[l].mul(c[r])
                                .mul(new Mint(i + 1, 0))
                                .mul(comb[i - 1][l])
                );
            }
            a[i] = tmp;
            c[i] = tmpc;
        }

        // Initialize dpc
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dpc[i][j][0] = new Mint(0);
                dpc[i][j][1] = new Mint(0);
            }
        }
        dpc[0][0][0] = new Mint(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;
                dpc[i][j][0] = dpc[i - 1][j][0].add(dpc[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    dpc[i][j][1] = dpc[i][j][1].add(c[k].mul(comb[j][k]).mul(dpc[i - k][j - k][0]));
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize dp
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j][0] = new Mint(0);
                dp[i][j][1] = new Mint(0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                if (j > i) continue;
                dp[i][j][0] = dp[i - 1][j][0].add(dp[i - 1][j][1]);
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    Mint term1 = a[k].mul(comb[j][k]).mul(dpc[i - k][j - k][0]);
                    Mint term2 = dp[i - k][j - k][0].mul(c[k]).mul(comb[j][k]);
                    dp[i][j][1] = dp[i][j][1].add(term1).add(term2);
                }
            }
        }

        Mint result = dp[(int) n][(int) m][0].add(dp[(int) n][(int) m][1]);
        System.out.println(result.x);
    }

    static long s1(long l, long r) {
        if (l > r) return 0;
        return (l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    }

    static void gen_comb(int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = new Mint(1);
            comb[i][i] = new Mint(1);
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1].add(comb[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }
    }

    static class Mint {
        long x;

        Mint(long _x) {
            if (_x >= 0) {
                this.x = _x % mod;
            } else {
                this.x = (_x % mod + mod) % mod;
            }
        }

        Mint add(Mint b) {
            return new Mint((this.x + b.x) % mod);
        }

        Mint mul(Mint b) {
            return new Mint((this.x * b.x) % mod);
        }

        Mint inv() {
            return new Mint(modInverse(this.x, mod));
        }

        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(x);
        }

        // Modular inverse using Extended Euclidean Algorithm
        static long modInverse(long a, long m) {
            long m0 = m, t, q;
            long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
            if (m == 1) return 0;
            while (a > 1) {
                q = a / m;
                t = m;
                m = a % m;
                a = t;
                t = x0;
                x0 = x1 - q * x0;
                x1 = t;
            }
            if (x1 < 0) x1 += m0;
            return x1;
        }
    }
}
